decision_text:
# Initial decision: bounded CMA-ES block

The public task is minimization of a deterministic scalar black box in 10 real coordinates, each in [-5, 5], with no additional constraints and no prior observations. The hard campaign budget is 2,000 objective calls. Smoothness, separability, multimodality and the optimum are unknown. I assume only the stated determinism; no identity inference or private-source inspection is used.

Use CMA-ES through the installed pycma 4.5.0 supported ask/tell API. The provided wrapper was inspected, but the underlying API permits an explicit population size. Initialize the mean at the box center (all zeros), isotropic standard deviation sigma0=2.5 (one quarter of box width), population size 16, seed 20261022, active covariance adaptation enabled, and full covariance from the start (CMA_diagonal=0). Enforce [-5,5] through pycma's bounds/BoundTransform handling. Other adaptation and termination parameters inherit pycma 4.5.0 defaults; logging and verbose output are disabled. NumPy is 2.4.6. Evaluate the center once as an observed reference, then run ten complete generations, updating the distribution after each generation. The center observation is retained in campaign history but is not inserted into a CMA generation.

This derivative-free, rank-based method is suitable without assuming smoothness or known objective scale. A population of 16 provides broader selection than the dimension-based default of 10 while retaining ten adaptation cycles in a modest initial block. The initial distribution spans a substantial part of the box without requiring observations from a separate design.

**Step limit:** at most 161 additional objective calls; pause at cumulative evaluation 161 (one center plus 10 x 16 candidates). Ten generations allow a first assessment of movement and scale adaptation while preserving most of the budget for evidence-based decisions. The runner checks the block and total allowance before every call, and a generation starts only when it fits.

At the checkpoint inspect the center value, best observed value and location, generation minima/medians, distribution step size, covariance axis ratio, and boundary proximity. Determine whether the population is producing sustained improvement and whether its spread is appropriate; there is no preselected following method. Pause sooner if a pycma termination condition is reached at a generation boundary, a nonfinite value occurs, or the evaluator reports an error. On evaluator error, stop without retrying the unknown call. Save the harness output at the checkpoint. Preserve the live harness and optimizer state between blocks.

## Decision after evaluation 161
**Budget:** 161 used / 2000 total; 1839 remaining.
**Evidence:** Center value 107.72655268574587; best 64.86986110241332 at evaluation 110. Generation medians moved from 119.1104 to 113.7309, but recent minima were 94.1226, 99.5739 and 101.8102. Sigma adapted from 2.5 to 2.04797 and covariance axis ratio reached 1.8934. The best point's tenth coordinate is 4.99828, near the upper bound. Values are deterministic, but sparse samples leave uncertainty about basin width and global structure. Three generations without improvement do not establish failure.
**Decision:** Continue CMA-ES using the same live mean, covariance, evolution paths, RNG and step size. Retain all observations and the same harness.
**Hyperparameters:** Unchanged from roadmap_initial.md (pycma 4.5.0, population 16, active full covariance, bounds). Retain adaptive sigma rather than imposing an unvalidated contraction; the population has only completed ten adaptation cycles.
**Reason:** The best value improved by 42.8567, and covariance is still developing. More generations will test whether selection can improve typical values and repeatedly enter the promising region.
**Next step limit:** 192 additional objective calls; pause at cumulative evaluation 353.
**Why this length:** Twelve complete generations provide slightly more adaptation than the first block while limiting exposure to a method whose median improvement remains modest.
**Review:** Inspect new best, generation minima/medians, sigma, axis ratio, and mean/boundary location. Pause earlier at any CMA termination condition, nonfinite value or evaluator error; evaluator errors stop the campaign without retry.

## Decision after evaluation 353
**Budget:** 353 used / 2000 total; 1647 remaining.
**Evidence:** Best improved from 64.86986110241332 to 63.204228438481245 (evaluation 322). More importantly, generation median declined from 113.7309 at generation 10 to 83.1423 at generation 22, with medians around 98 at generations 19-20. Sigma contracted from 2.04797 to 1.28489 and axis ratio is 2.4851. Latest generation minimum is 64.4542, close to the best. The best point has coordinates 1 and 8 near bounds. The reported CMA mean is an internal unbounded genotype, transformed by BoundTransform before evaluation; it is not itself an evaluated point.
**Decision:** Continue the same CMA-ES run, preserving all distribution and RNG state and all observations.
**Hyperparameters:** Unchanged initial configuration from roadmap_initial.md, pycma 4.5.0. Population 16 still yields useful selection, and endogenous scale contraction is now effective, so no restart or manual sigma change is justified.
**Reason:** Consistent population improvement supplies stronger evidence than the modest best-value change alone. The current distribution is concentrating into a promising region and is far from a termination condition.
**Next step limit:** 256 additional objective calls; pause at cumulative evaluation 609.
**Why this length:** Sixteen generations give the contracting distribution enough time to convert broad progress into better minima; this somewhat longer block follows stronger evidence of progress while retaining 1391 calls beyond the checkpoint.
**Review:** Inspect generation medians/minima, cumulative best, sigma, covariance conditioning, and feasible best location. Pause at any library termination condition, nonfinite result or evaluator error.

## Decision after evaluation 609
**Budget:** 609 used / 2000 total; 1391 remaining.
**Evidence:** The last 256 calls reduced best from 63.204228438481245 to 54.11457773213685 (evaluation 601). Latest population median is 54.89834; sigma fell to 0.330775 and axis ratio is 2.4939. Recent generation minima improved repeatedly, and values are now concentrated in a local region. The best point is 0.16183 above the lower bound in coordinate 8; other coordinates are further from boundaries. These observations support local structure but do not establish differentiability or global optimality.
**Decision:** Switch evaluations to BOBYQA initialized at the best actually evaluated point. Suspend and retain CMA state; start a new local interpolation model. Preserve all observations and the same harness/counter. Use a campaign-local queue adapter following the provided wrapper's pattern, because the wrapper fixes the initialization and radius. The solver thread proposes points and waits; only the main thread evaluates. This preserves the full local solver state across block checkpoints.
**Hyperparameters:** Py-BOBYQA 1.5.0; npt=21 (2d+1), rhobeg=0.3 in original coordinates, rhoend=1e-7, scaling_within_bounds=False, objfun_has_noise=False, seek_global_minimum=False, restarts.use_restarts=False. Bounds remain [-5,5]. maxfun=1391 is an internal ceiling, while the main-thread gate enforces this block's 160-call maximum. Other trust-region and model-update settings inherit Py-BOBYQA 1.5.0 defaults. Its supported initialization may move the near-boundary coordinate to accommodate the starting radius. No objective values are reused as unevaluated results.
**Reason:** CMA has localized successfully. A local quadratic trust-region method can test whether this apparent basin admits cheaper progress than population updates, without relying on small finite-difference gradients. Radius 0.3 matches the recent sampling scale; 21 interpolation points limits model-building expense in ten dimensions.
**Next step limit:** 160 additional objective calls; pause at cumulative evaluation 769, or earlier if BOBYQA returns.
**Why this length:** This covers the initial 21-point model and roughly 139 refinement/geometry calls, enough to assess local progress before committing more budget.
**Review:** Inspect local best trajectory, displacement, convergence status and numerical issues. Pause if the solver finishes; stop on any evaluator error or nonfinite result without retrying.

## Decision after evaluation 760
**Budget:** 760 used / 2000 total; 1240 remaining.
**Evidence:** BOBYQA returned successfully after 151 of the permitted 160 calls because rho reached rhoend=1e-7. Best is 53.63458891488197 at evaluation 759. Local values after 80 calls were already 53.6345896713, so about 71 subsequent calls gained less than 7.6e-7. The approximate local gradient is below 1e-7 in absolute components, but this is model evidence, not a global certificate. A read-only diversity check found evaluation 110 (value 64.86986110241332) at Euclidean distance 7.17718 from the incumbent; it is the best observed point at least 3 units away. No additional objective calls were made during this check.
**Decision:** Restart BOBYQA at the observed point from evaluation 110. Reset its interpolation model and trust region because this is a different candidate basin. Preserve both prior optimizer states/results, all observed data and the same harness.
**Hyperparameters:** Py-BOBYQA 1.5.0; npt=21 and other settings from the decision at 609 remain unchanged. Increase rhobeg to 0.75 because this isolated seed has not undergone local concentration; relax rhoend to 1e-5 because the first solver spent many calls on sub-micro-unit improvements. Internal maxfun=1240; main-thread block limit=180. Automatic restarts remain disabled. The solver may adjust near-boundary initialization, and every requested point is evaluated normally.
**Reason:** Local convergence and a spatially distinct promising observation justify investigating another basin. The new radius covers more of the seed's neighborhood; the precision change focuses evaluations on meaningful differences between basins.
**Next step limit:** 180 additional objective calls; pause at cumulative evaluation 940, or earlier on solver return.
**Why this length:** The first local run needed 151 calls; 180 gives the wider-radius restart room to build its 21-point model and descend, with a bounded opportunity cost.
**Review:** Compare the new basin minimum with 53.63458891488197, track local progress and final distance to previous solution, and inspect convergence or solver errors. Stop without retry on evaluator errors or nonfinite results.

## Decision after evaluation 940
**Budget:** 940 used / 2000 total; 1060 remaining.
**Evidence:** The restarted BOBYQA run improved from its seed value 64.86986110241332 to 43.07080022103731 at evaluation 939, beating the previous basin minimum by 10.56379. Its best values at local calls 40/80/120/160/180 were 48.15414/44.58556/43.48887/43.11374/43.07080. The solver has not returned; the last 40 calls improved by 0.09535. The new solution has moved substantially from the seed, including coordinate 10 from about 5 to 0.53.
**Decision:** Continue the same live BOBYQA solver with its interpolation model, trust radius, pending proposal and all observations retained.
**Hyperparameters:** Unchanged configuration from the decision at 760 (Py-BOBYQA 1.5.0, initial rhobeg=0.75, rhoend=1e-5, npt=21, no internal restarts). The initial radius is historical; the current radius continues library adaptation. Do not discard a model that is still descending.
**Reason:** This run has established a much better basin and still makes meaningful progress. Continued refinement is supported, while diminishing recent gains justify a nearer checkpoint.
**Next step limit:** 120 additional objective calls; pause at cumulative evaluation 1060, or earlier on solver return.
**Why this length:** About six initial-model sizes permit further trust-region refinement, shorter than the previous 180-call block because convergence may now be closer.
**Review:** Assess improvement rate, convergence status and whether the local values stabilize. Pause on solver return; stop on evaluator error or nonfinite objective without retrying.

## Decision after evaluation 1060
**Budget:** 1060 used / 2000 total; 940 remaining.
**Evidence:** Continuing the second local run reduced best from 43.07080022103731 to 43.03587542293864. Last 40-call gain is 0.00027481; the last 20 gained 0.00006149. The solver has not terminated, so convergence is not claimed. Read-only checks of existing observations show many low-valued candidates are within 3-4 units of explored paths. With minimum Euclidean distance 5 from every evaluated point in both local trajectories, the best remaining seed is evaluation 212, value 88.63256063574748, distance 7.15580. These checks used no objective calls.
**Decision:** Suspend the active local solver with its model and pending request intact. Start a third BOBYQA run at evaluation 212. Retain the prior CMA state, local states/results, all observations and the same harness.
**Hyperparameters:** Py-BOBYQA 1.5.0; npt=21, rhoend=1e-5, bounds and other settings as at 760, with no internal restarts. Set rhobeg=1.0 because this less-refined seed is far from both explored local trajectories. maxfun=940 internally; enforce 180 objective calls at the main-thread boundary. New interpolation state is required for the new seed.
**Reason:** Diminishing improvements in the current basin make a spatially distinct search attractive. The second basin improved the incumbent by over 10 units, so basin choice has demonstrated material value. A known remote seed avoids paying again for its initial discovery, though its starting value does not guarantee a better local minimum.
**Next step limit:** 180 additional objective calls; pause at cumulative evaluation 1240, or earlier if the solver returns.
**Why this length:** The second wider-radius run established its much better basin within 180 calls. The same allowance is useful here as a bounded test of a new, less-localized seed; most remaining calls stay uncommitted.
**Review:** Inspect local best, displacement from previous paths, improvement rate and return status. Stop without retry on evaluator errors/nonfinite results.

## Decision after evaluation 1240
**Budget:** 1240 used / 2000 total; 760 remaining.
**Evidence:** The third local run reduced its seed value 88.63256063574748 to 43.927113406500006 in 180 calls. Its best at local calls 120/140/160/180 was 45.82914/45.15652/44.76543/43.92711, a 1.22941 gain in the last 40 and 0.83832 in the last 20. The campaign best remains 43.03587542293864. The solver remains active, with no numerical or evaluation errors.
**Decision:** Continue this third BOBYQA run, preserving its interpolation model, current trust-region state, pending proposal and all observed data.
**Hyperparameters:** Unchanged from decision 1060 (Py-BOBYQA 1.5.0, initial radius 1.0, final radius 1e-5, npt=21 and no internal restarts). Recent progress does not justify paying to rebuild the model.
**Reason:** Although not yet better than the incumbent, this run is within 0.89124 and its recent gain is substantial. Abandoning it now would ignore the observed descent trend.
**Next step limit:** 120 additional objective calls; pause at cumulative evaluation 1360, or sooner on solver return.
**Why this length:** Enough for several local model refinements while placing a checkpoint before the remaining budget becomes small. The current strong descent supports continuation, but incumbent improvement remains uncertain.
**Review:** Inspect new local/global best, improvement rate and distance to earlier local solutions. Pause on solver return and stop without retry on evaluator errors/nonfinite values.

## Decision after evaluation 1360
**Budget:** 1360 used / 2000 total; 640 remaining.
**Evidence:** The third BOBYQA run reached 42.92271292982666 at evaluation 1359, improving the campaign best by 0.11316249. Its best point is 10.09925 units from the previous basin's best, establishing a spatially distinct region. Last 40-call local improvement was 0.10604 and last 20-call improvement 0.03721. It has not converged. All global discovery so far came from one CMA run whose later distribution concentrated near the first basin; broad coverage outside its trajectory is uncertain.
**Decision:** Suspend the third local solver with its state retained. Switch this block to a fresh scrambled Sobol design over the entire box. Preserve all prior data and optimizer states and use the same harness.
**Hyperparameters:** Provided src.optimizers.sobol_search.SobolSearch using SciPy 1.17.1 qmc.Sobol, dimension 10, scramble=True, seed=20261023, standard SciPy defaults for other sampler settings. Affine scaling maps each coordinate from [0,1] to [-5,5]. Draw 128 points without adaptive filtering or rejection. No fitted surrogate or estimated objective values are used.
**Reason:** Distinct local basins have materially different values, and the current run's incumbent gain is becoming small. A global coverage check has option value while enough budget remains to act on its evidence. This does not assert local convergence or promise a better basin.
**Next step limit:** 128 additional objective calls; pause at cumulative evaluation 1488.
**Why this length:** 128 is a power of two, preserving the Sobol design's balance. It gives a meaningful fresh box-wide sample in ten dimensions, costs one fifth of the remaining budget, and leaves 512 calls uncommitted.
**Review:** Inspect the fresh design's value distribution, best points and distances from prior local trajectories. Compare opportunities supported by these observations with retained solver progress. Stop on nonfinite values or evaluator errors without retry.

## Decision after evaluation 1488
**Budget:** 1488 used / 2000 total; 512 remaining.
**Evidence:** The 128 Sobol values ranged from 104.43236546147577 to 126.96042609222658, median 121.05914. None improved the campaign best 42.92271292982666. The design's best point is evaluation 1380 and is 8.88425 units from all prior local trajectory points. Sparse global coverage cannot certify that this high starting value precludes a useful local basin; previous seeds at 64.86986 and 88.63256 both descended to around 43.
**Decision:** Start BOBYQA at evaluation 1380 as a bounded test of a fresh remote region. Keep all earlier solvers suspended with states retained; reset only this new run's interpolation model. Continue using the same harness and observations.
**Hyperparameters:** Py-BOBYQA 1.5.0; npt=21, rhobeg=0.75, rhoend=1e-5, maxfun=512. Bounds, determinism, no automatic restarts and other inherited defaults as in decision 760. Radius 0.75 suits an unrefined seed and fits its nearest-boundary distance (about 0.872), retaining its location without an initialization shift.
**Reason:** This point supplies new spatial evidence beyond the CMA path. Its relatively high objective makes the opportunity uncertain, so test a local descent with a smaller allowance rather than presuming it deserves a long run.
**Next step limit:** 120 additional objective calls; pause at cumulative evaluation 1608, or sooner on solver return.
**Why this length:** Covers a 21-point initial model and 99 additional calls. This should reveal a useful descent trend while leaving 392 evaluations uncommitted and all previous optimizer states available.
**Review:** Compare local progress with prior runs at similar call counts and with the incumbent, inspect geometry and any convergence, and reconsider the best use of remaining calls. Stop on evaluator errors/nonfinite values without retrying.

## Decision after evaluation 1608
**Budget:** 1608 used / 2000 total; 392 remaining.
**Evidence:** BOBYQA from the Sobol seed descended from 104.43236546147577 to 42.971022219649186 in 120 calls, only 0.04830929 above the incumbent. Best at local calls 60/80/100/120 was 46.87326/44.00115/43.02976/42.97102. Coordinate 6 is at its upper bound 5. The solver is still active; the last 20 calls improved by 0.05874274. This is much faster local descent than the seed's initial ranking suggested.
**Decision:** Continue the same fourth local run and retain its current interpolation and trust-region state. All earlier runs remain suspended and available.
**Hyperparameters:** Unchanged from decision 1488 (Py-BOBYQA 1.5.0, npt=21, initial rhobeg=0.75, rhoend=1e-5, no internal restarts). The bound is handled by the solver; do not perturb a coordinate away from an active bound without evidence.
**Reason:** The run is close to the incumbent and still improving, warranting a short opportunity to establish its local floor.
**Next step limit:** 80 additional objective calls; pause at cumulative evaluation 1688, or earlier on solver return.
**Why this length:** Roughly four model sizes is enough for local refinement, and the shorter allowance reflects the diminished progress and 392-call remaining budget.
**Review:** Inspect whether it beats 42.92271292982666, convergence, final improvement rate and bound activity. Pause on solver return; stop without retry on evaluator errors/nonfinite values.

## Decision after evaluation 1688
**Budget:** 1688 used / 2000 total; 312 remaining.
**Evidence:** The fourth local run improved from 42.971022219649186 to 42.831316806860244 in 80 calls, beating the previous incumbent by 0.09139612. At local calls 140/160/180/200 its best was 42.89596/42.86518/42.84380/42.83132; each 20-call segment improved. Coordinate 6 moved from the exact upper bound to 4.99331, so the solver is still adjusting constraint activity. It has not returned.
**Decision:** Continue the fourth BOBYQA run with its full state and pending proposal retained. Keep other paused runs and all observations available.
**Hyperparameters:** Unchanged configuration from decision 1488, Py-BOBYQA 1.5.0. The adaptive trust region continues normally. Retaining the fitted model avoids new initialization overhead with only 312 calls left.
**Reason:** This is now the best measured basin and has a sustained descent trend. No observed evidence favors discarding its state for a new method or a higher-valued basin.
**Next step limit:** 100 additional objective calls; pause at cumulative evaluation 1788, or earlier on solver return.
**Why this length:** Approximately five interpolation-model sizes gives the active run room to refine while keeping more than 200 calls beyond the checkpoint for an informed decision. This is not a commitment of the remaining budget.
**Review:** Inspect objective improvement, convergence, location and bound activity. Pause on solver return; stop without retry on evaluator errors/nonfinite values.

## Decision after evaluation 1788
**Budget:** 1788 used / 2000 total; 212 remaining.
**Evidence:** Continuing the fourth run improved best from 42.831316806860244 to 42.82513063405987, a gain of 0.00618617 in 100 calls. Last 20-call gain was 0.00056262; coordinate 6 is again at 5. The solver remains active, so local convergence is not claimed. The next-best Sobol observation is evaluation 1427, value 106.09743664776924, previously 9.56727 units from the first three local paths. The first Sobol seed, despite a similar starting value of 104.43237, led to the current best basin.
**Decision:** Suspend the fourth solver without losing its interpolation or pending request. Start a fifth BOBYQA run at evaluation 1427, retaining all other optimizer states, actual observations and the same harness.
**Hyperparameters:** Py-BOBYQA 1.5.0; npt=21, rhobeg=0.75, rhoend=1e-5, internal maxfun=212, no restarts, other settings as in decision 1488. The candidate is comfortably within bounds, so radius 0.75 retains its initialization. A new model is necessary at this remote seed.
**Reason:** The incumbent basin now offers only small observed marginal gains. Testing another globally sampled region has a plausible larger upside, supported by the preceding Sobol-seeded success, but remains uncertain; the current best is retained regardless.
**Next step limit:** 120 additional objective calls; pause at cumulative evaluation 1908, or earlier on solver return.
**Why this length:** This matches the short test that revealed the previous Sobol seed's promise, covering initialization and roughly 99 refinement calls. It leaves 92 calls uncommitted for a decision based on new evidence rather than automatically spending the remaining budget here.
**Review:** Inspect local best, rate of improvement, distance from previous trajectories and competitiveness with the incumbent. Pause on solver return; stop on evaluator errors/nonfinite values without retrying.

## Decision after evaluation 1908
**Budget:** 1908 used / 2000 total; 92 remaining.
**Evidence:** The fifth local run reached 50.26128546420575, but its last 20 calls improved by only 0.00017560 and it remains 7.43615 above the incumbent. Its seed was indeed 9.56727 units from every prior local trajectory. The best fourth run was paused at 42.82513063405987 after 300 local calls, with a 0.00618617 gain over its last 100 and 0.00056262 over its last 20. Earlier other basins stand at 53.63459, 43.03588 and 42.92271.
**Decision:** Suspend the fifth run and resume the fourth, incumbent-producing BOBYQA solver, preserving exactly its interpolation model, trust radius, pending proposal and numerical state from evaluation 1788. Keep all observations and the same harness.
**Hyperparameters:** The resumed run's configuration is unchanged from decision 1488 (Py-BOBYQA 1.5.0, npt=21, rhoend=1e-5, no internal restarts). Its maxfun=512 internal ceiling remains, but the campaign gate permits only 92 more calls. Tag these calls bobyqa_refine_best to make the resumed allocation clear.
**Reason:** The new region has nearly settled at a substantially worse value. The best retained solver has demonstrated remaining descent and requires no initialization; 92 calls would be a limited allowance for discovering and refining another basin. Refining this observed best is the strongest supported use of the remaining budget.
**Next step limit:** 92 additional objective calls; pause at cumulative evaluation 2000, or earlier on solver return.
**Why this length:** This is close to the 100-call refinement block that still yielded measurable progress, and it uses the remaining calls on a stateful model with no startup cost. The full remainder is chosen because that evidence supports this refinement horizon, not because an earlier schedule allocated it.
**Review:** Record the best actually observed result and solver status. Stop at the hard budget, or reconsider if the solver returns earlier. Stop without retry on evaluator errors/nonfinite values.
